cues.zh: 撒切尔将英国电力系统私有化，并引入了这样一个理念
cues.en: Thatcher privatised the electricity system in the UK and introduced the idea

cues.zh: 私有化对人民是件好事。
cues.en: that privatization is a good thing for the people.

cues.zh: 其理念是，市场比国家更懂得如何降低成本。
cues.en: The idea being that the market knows better how to reduce costs than the state.

cues.zh: 第一步是问：你现在的电费是多少？
cues.en: The first step was to say: how much are you paying for your electricity?

cues.zh: 你付50英镑，我不知道是多少千瓦时；
cues.en: You pay £50 per I don't know how many kilowatt hours;

cues.zh: 我们要给它设个上限，
cues.en: we're going to cap it,

cues.zh: 不允许价格超过你现在支付的水平。
cues.en: We're not going to allow the price to go beyond what you're paying.

cues.zh: 然后我们进行私有化，让竞争把价格降下来。
cues.en: And then we're going to privatize, and we will allow competition to bring it down.

cues.zh: 如果降下来了，你消费者就受益。
cues.en: If it brings it down, you gain, consumer.

cues.zh: 如果没能成功，价格仍然封顶在50，所以你没有任何损失。
cues.en: If they don't succeed, it's still capped at 50, so you've got nothing to lose.

cues.zh: 你只有可能获益。
cues.en: You only have things to gain.

cues.zh: 那是一个非常有说服力的论点。
cues.en: That was a very powerful argument.

cues.zh: 再加上他们把股份分发给民众
cues.en: If you add to that the fact that they were giving away shares to the people

cues.zh: 而民众后来当然把股份卖给了寡头，
cues.en: who then of course sold them to the oligarchs,

cues.zh: 私有化就变得无法阻挡了。
cues.en: it was impossible to stop privatization.

cues.zh: 第二阶段是说：“但作为政治家，我凭什么来决定
cues.en: The second phase was saying: "but who am I as a politician to be deciding

cues.zh: 最高价格的上限？
cues.en: the cap of the maximum price?

cues.zh: 为什么要由政治家来决定？让市场来决定吧！”
cues.en: Why should politicians decide? Let the market do it!"

cues.zh: 与其让部长们决定最高价格，
cues.en: Instead of having ministers deciding the maximum price,

cues.zh: 我们要模拟一个市场
cues.en: we're going to simulate a market

cues.zh: 但说到电力，我们没法有市场。
cues.en: But we can't have a market, when it comes to electricity.

cues.zh: 为什么电力就不能有市场呢？
cues.en: Why can't we have a market when it comes to electricity?

cues.zh: 你想，如果有30条、50条不同的电缆通到你家
cues.en: If there were, you know, 30, 50 different electrical cables coming into your home

cues.zh: 你可以选择从哪一条取电，
cues.en: and you could choose which one you were going to take your electricity from,

cues.zh: 那才叫市场。
cues.en: then it would be a market.

cues.zh: 不同供应商之间就会有某种竞争。
cues.en: There would be some kind of competition between different providers.

cues.zh: 但当然，让50个电网穿过每个国家的每栋房子、每条街道，
cues.en: But, of course it would be stupid to have 50 grids

cues.zh: 那才是愚蠢的。
cues.en: going through every house and every street in every country.

cues.zh: 所以这就是他们模拟市场的原因。他们是怎么做的呢？
cues.en: So this is why they simulate the market. How do they do that?

cues.zh: 他们说：好，我们要把电力公司拆分
cues.en: They say: okay, we're going to split the electricity companies

cues.zh: 成至少三个部分。
cues.en: in at least three parts.

cues.zh: 第一部分是发电。
cues.en: The first will be power generation.

cues.zh: 于是每座发电厂变成一家公司，或由某家公司拥有
cues.en: So each power plant becomes a company or is owned by some company

cues.zh: 这家公司可能拥有不止一座；
cues.en: that may own more than one;

cues.zh: 这些公司相互竞争
cues.en: and these companies compete with one another

cues.zh: 在批发市场上，为系统提供一个批发价格。
cues.en: in the wholesale Market, to provide the system with a wholesale price.

cues.zh: 第二部分是网络，也就是电网，属于另一家公司。
cues.en: The second part is the network, the grid, that belongs to another company.

cues.zh: 然后是电力离开电网、进入你家的那部分。
cues.en: And then there is the part where electricity leaves the grid to go into your home.

cues.zh: 正是在那里，你建立起相互竞争的电力供应商
cues.en: And that's where you create electricity providers who compete with one another

cues.zh: 它们参与的市场是：从电网买电，而电网的电是从
cues.en: in the market of buying the electricity from the grid, which has bought it

cues.zh: 发电商那里买来的，然后再卖给消费者。
cues.en: from the producers, and then selling it to the consumers.

cues.zh: 你模拟生产者之间的竞争。
cues.en: You simulate competition between the producers.

cues.zh: 他们产生批发价，
cues.en: They produce the wholesale price,

cues.zh: 然后你有供应商之间相互竞争，
cues.en: and then you have providers who are competing with

cues.zh: 以促成竞争，
cues.en: one another to allow competition

cues.zh: 来缩小批发价和零售价之间的差距。
cues.en: to shrink the distance between the wholesale price and the retail price.

cues.zh: 那就是第二阶段私有化——这是目前盛行的做法，
cues.en: That is phase-2 privatization - and this is what is now prevailing

cues.zh: 在欧盟。他们照搬了撒切尔主义的第二阶段模式。
cues.en: in the European Union. They copied the Thatcherite phase-2 model.

cues.zh: 当你模拟市场时，你需要有政府强加的规则，
cues.en: When you simulate the market, you need to have government imposed rules

cues.zh: 仅仅是因为你没有真正的市场。
cues.en: simply because you don't have a real market.

cues.zh: 你有一个政府，假装着，模拟着一个市场。
cues.en: You have a government, pretending, simulating a market.

cues.zh: 当涉及正规的拍卖，有人在卖东西时，
cues.en: When it comes to a proper auction and you've got people selling stuff,

cues.zh: 你会期望出价最低的公司或个人获胜。
cues.en: you would expect that the company or the person offering the lowest price, wins.

cues.zh: 对吧？不！在这个市场里，出价最高的公司获胜。
cues.en: Right? No! In this market, the company offering the highest price wins.

cues.zh: 只要他们提供的电力总和不超过一定量，每个人的价格就都一样，
cues.en: And then the price is the same for everybody as long as the sum of

cues.zh: 只要他们提供的电力总和不超过一定量，
cues.en: the electricity that they have provided is no more than a certain amount,

cues.zh: 这正是市场所要求的。
cues.en: which is what the market demands.

cues.zh: 这太疯狂了，然后据称供应商之间会相互竞争
cues.en: It's madness, and then supposedly the providers compete with one another

cues.zh: 把零售价压低到那个最高批发价。
cues.en: to reduce the retail price to that maximum wholesale price.

cues.zh: 现在，如果这听起来很复杂，那是因为它本来就被设计得很复杂。
cues.en: Now, if this sounds complicated, it is because it was intended to be complicated.

cues.zh: 目的是让欧洲公民不明白这是针对他们的骗局，
cues.en: So that the citizens of Europe do not understand that this is a scam against them,

cues.zh: 甚至在光景好的时候也是如此。
cues.en: even during the good times.

cues.zh: 证据就是，自私有化以来，生产平均一千瓦时电的成本
cues.en: Proof of that is that since privatization, the difference between the cost of producing

cues.zh: 与零售价之间的差距已经扩大了两倍。
cues.en: an average kilowatt hour and the retail price has tripled.

cues.zh: 所以，别相信任何告诉你问题与这个体系无关的人。
cues.en: So don't believe anyone who tells you that the problem has nothing to do with the system.

cues.zh: 问题在于生产成本在上涨。
cues.en: The problem is that the cost of production is going up.

cues.zh: 是的，生产成本在上涨
cues.en: Yes, the cost of production is going up

cues.zh: 因为天然气价格在上涨。
cues.en: because the price of natural gas is going up.

cues.zh: 但这并不能解释为什么企业的利润率在变大。
cues.en: But that does not explain why the profit margin of the firms is getting larger.

cues.zh: 这一点大家都清楚了吗？
cues.en: Are we clear on this?

cues.zh: 我在希腊议会发言，揭露了一场骗局
cues.en: I spoke in the Greek Parliament and I exposed a scam

cues.zh: 是希腊政府的骗局。
cues.en: of the Greek government.

cues.zh: 我们在议会提出了一项提案
cues.en: We represented in Parliament a proposal

cues.zh: 关于如何保护消费者免受价格飞涨的影响。
cues.en: on how to shield consumers from skyrocketing prices.

cues.zh: 我们说的是：这太荒唐了，
cues.en: What we said was this: it is crazy that,

cues.zh: 因为用天然气发的电价格飞涨，
cues.en: because the price of electricity produced from natural gas is skyrocketing,

cues.zh: （因为天然气价格已经飞涨）……
cues.en: (because the price of natural gas has skyrocketed)…

cues.zh: 我认为这太荒唐、荒唐至极，太阳能板发出的电
cues.en: I think it's crazy, crazy mad, that electricity coming out of solar panels

cues.zh: 发电成本几乎为零（一旦有了太阳能板，就是免费的）……
cues.en: which costs nothing to produce, (once you have the solar panel) it is free…

cues.zh: 那家出售太阳能发电千瓦时的私营公司，竟然应该
cues.en: that the private company that is selling solar produced kilowatt hours should

cues.zh: 为那一千瓦时拿到和用
cues.en: get for that kilowatt hour the same price that it would get had it produced it from

cues.zh: 最昂贵的天然气发电时一样的价格。
cues.en: the most expensive natural gas.

cues.zh: 这太疯狂了，对吧？
cues.en: It is mad, right?

cues.zh: 你要做的就是消除这些超额利润。
cues.en: All you need to do is to eliminate these super profits.

cues.zh: 我是说：我怎么看出这是个骗局的？
cues.en: I mean: how did I understand that it's a scam?

cues.zh: 因为他们不会告诉你：“脚注3.8。骗局就在这里。”
cues.en: Because they don't tell you: “Footnote 3.8. This is where the scam is.”

cues.zh: 你得自己做些侦探工作，自己去破解。
cues.en: You've got to do some detective work, decipher it yourself.

cues.zh: 我们最初察觉到这是个骗局
cues.en: The first inkling we had that this is a scam

cues.zh: 是当它提到批发价格的每日拍卖仍在继续时。
cues.en: is when it mentioned that the daily auction for the wholesale price continues.

cues.zh: 这个证券交易所，批发生产商在其中相互竞争
cues.en: This Stock Exchange, in which wholesale producers are competing with one another

cues.zh: 通过拍卖进行竞争，仍在继续。
cues.en: in an auction, continues.

cues.zh: 现在，人的大脑无法理解这一点。
cues.en: Now, the human mind cannot wrap itself around that.

cues.zh: 如果政府对每一座
cues.en: If you have a maximum price that is imposed by government on every single

cues.zh: 发电站都规定了最高价格，为什么还需要拍卖？
cues.en: Power Station, why do you need the auction?

cues.zh: 这难道不是显而易见该问的问题吗？
cues.en: Isn't that the obvious question to ask?

cues.zh: 现在就是这样，这就是他们的做法：记住，每兆瓦时的价格
cues.en: Now here it is, this is what they do: remember, the price for every megawatt hour

cues.zh: 政府给水电站规定的是85欧元。
cues.en: that the government imposed on hydropower plants was 85 Euros.

cues.zh: 我看了拍卖的结果，价格：这段时间是700。
cues.en: I looked at what the auction yielded, the price: it was 700 during this period.

cues.zh: 700！那些千瓦时的价格上限
cues.en: 700! The price cap for those kilowatt hours

cues.zh: 由水电站生产的，本该是85。
cues.en: produced by hydropower plants was meant to be 85.

cues.zh: 所以事情是这样的：那一千瓦时，或者兆瓦时的生产商
cues.en: So this is how it works: the producer of that kilowatt hour, or megawatt hour

cues.zh: 收到由拍卖决定的700欧元
cues.en: receives 700 euros that has been determined by the auction

cues.zh: 在荷兰，
cues.en: in the Netherlands,

cues.zh: 但之后他们必须把差额还给希腊政府，
cues.en: but then they have to give back to the Greek State the difference between

cues.zh: 700和112的价格上限之间的差额，也就是588。
cues.en: the 700 and the price cap of 112, which is 588.

cues.zh: 所以他们还给了政府。好，到目前为止，你觉得这很愚蠢。
cues.en: So they give it back to the government. Okay, so far, you think it's stupid.

cues.zh: 我是说：为什么要这样做？
cues.en: I mean: why do this?

cues.zh: 为什么不直接让他们收112，而不是收700
cues.en: Why don't you just ask them to receive 112 instead of receiving 700

cues.zh: 然后再退还588？
cues.en: and then have to return the 588?

cues.zh: 到目前为止，没有骗局，只是愚蠢，
cues.en: So far, no scam, just stupidity,

cues.zh: 只是官僚主义。
cues.en: just bureaucracy.

cues.zh: 骗局就在这里！
cues.en: Here's where the scam comes!

cues.zh: 政府收这笔钱可不是为了给消费者。不是！
cues.en: The government does not take this money in order to give it to Consumers. No!

cues.zh: 政府收这笔钱是为了给零售公司。
cues.en: The government takes this money to give it to the retail companies.

cues.zh: 现在，你看看欧洲几乎每一个市场，同一个股东
cues.en: Now, if you look at every market, almost, in Europe, the same shareholder that

cues.zh: 既拥有生产商，也拥有零售公司。
cues.en: owns the producer, owns the retail company.

cues.zh: 哈！抓到你了！
cues.en: Ha! Got you!

cues.zh: 所以就好像我有一家发电的公司，还有一家
cues.en: So it is as if I have a company that is producing electricity, and I have a

cues.zh: 零售公司。
cues.en: company that is a retail company.

cues.zh: 他们让这个所谓的拍卖把价格定在700。
cues.en: They let the pseudo auction determine the price at 700.

cues.zh: 他们强迫我从左边口袋，也就是我作为生产商的口袋，
cues.en: They force me to return to the state from my left pocket,

cues.zh: 向政府上缴588欧元，
cues.en: which is my pocket as a producer, 588 Euros to the government,

cues.zh: 然后政府把它放进我的右边口袋。
cues.en: and the government puts it in my right pocket.

cues.zh: 这还怪消费者感觉不到任何缓解吗？
cues.en: Now is it any wonder that the consumer feels no relief?

cues.zh: 不，一点都没有，零，完全没有。
cues.en: No, none, zero, zilch.

cues.zh: 然后，政府做的是：好吧，为了帮你，亲爱的消费者，
cues.en: Then, what the government does is: okay, to help you, dear consumer,

cues.zh: 我要去借钱。
cues.en: I'm going to borrow money.

cues.zh: 政府会借钱，加到政府预算里
cues.en: The government will borrow money and add it to the government budget

cues.zh: 去补贴你的电费，换句话说，就是让你把
cues.en: to subsidize your electricity bill, in other words, to allow you to give

cues.zh: 我口袋里的钱交给寡头，而这钱是政府从一个
cues.en: the oligarch the money in my pocket that the government has taken from one

cues.zh: 口袋掏出来放进另一个口袋的。
cues.en: pocket and put in another pocket.

cues.zh: 如果这都不算骗局，那我真不知道骗局这个词是什么意思了。
cues.en: Now, if this is not a scam, I do not know what the word scam means.

cues.zh: 这就是骗局的定义。
cues.en: This is the definition of a scam.

cues.zh: 他们为什么这么做？
cues.en: Why are they doing this?

cues.zh: 因为复杂性符合寡头集团的利益。
cues.en: Because complexity is in the interest of the oligarchy.

cues.zh: 他们在搞价格上限，在补贴公众。
cues.en: They are imposing a price cap. They are subsidizing the public.

cues.zh: 所以政府是在做事了？
cues.en: So the government is doing something?

cues.zh: 不，政府什么都没做。
cues.en: No, the government's doing nothing.

cues.zh: 政府是寡头集团的代理人，他们是骗子，是小偷。
cues.en: The government are agents of the oligarchy, they are crooks and they are thieves.

cues.zh: 这是赤裸裸地在摧毁大多数欧洲人
cues.en: This is a clear-cut case of destroying the capacity of the majority of Europeans

cues.zh: 维持生计的能力，为的是寡头集团的利益，把两件事结合在一起：
cues.en: to make ends meet, in the interest of the oligarchy, combining two things:

cues.zh: 一方面，是撒切尔的市场原教旨主义，
cues.en: on the one hand, the market fundamentalism of Thatcher

cues.zh: 它制造了这个模拟市场……而这个市场已经让我们失望了……
cues.en: that creates the simulated market... which has failed us...

cues.zh: 伴随着国家主义；国家、借贷、不断增加的公共债务，
cues.en: with: statism; the state, borrowing, increasing public debt,

cues.zh: 这样国家就能补贴寡头，而不是补贴消费者。
cues.en: so that the state can subsidize the oligarchs, but not the consumers.

cues.zh: 唯一的解决办法就是立即放弃市场模式，
cues.en: The only solution to this is the immediate abandonment of the market model,

cues.zh: 关闭荷兰的拍卖行，
cues.en: the closure of the auction house in the Netherlands,

cues.zh: 这是你做任何其他事情之前的第一步。
cues.en: the first step before you do anything else.

cues.zh: 我们需要有适当的价格上限，既在批发层面，
cues.en: We need to have a proper price cap, both at the wholesale level and

cues.zh: 也在零售层面，这样人们支付的价格反映的是平均成本
cues.en: at the retail level, so that the price that people pay reflects average cost

cues.zh: 加上一个小百分比，给运营者一点利润。
cues.en: plus a small percentage, a little bit of profit for whoever is running the show.

cues.zh: 这是第一点，应该成为DiEM25在全欧洲的政策。
cues.en: That's number one that should be the DiEM25 policy across Europe.

cues.zh: 终结市场原教旨主义；终结市场的幻觉：炸毁市场。
cues.en: End market fundamentalism; end the delusion of markets: blow up markets.

cues.zh: 电力不可能有市场，因为只有一根
cues.en: There can be no market when it comes to electricity, because there's only one

cues.zh: 电线从你的墙里出来……不可能有市场。
cues.en: electricity cable coming out of your wall ... and there can be no market.

cues.zh: 当他们试图创造、模拟一个只有一根电缆从墙里伸出来的市场时，
cues.en: When they try to create, simulate a market with one cable coming out of the wall,

cues.zh: 他们是在欺骗社会。
cues.en: they are scamming society.

cues.zh: 第二点：我们需要一个能源联盟，一个绿色能源联盟。
cues.en: Point number two: we need an Energy Union, a green Energy Union.

cues.zh: 我们再也无法维持这种市场谬论，它让
cues.en: We can no longer sustain this fallacy of the market, which allows

cues.zh: 德国政府有自己的计划
cues.en: German government to have its own plans

cues.zh: 关于绿色转型。
cues.en: about the green transition.

cues.zh: 希腊政府，也有自己的计划。
cues.en: The Greek government, its own plans.

cues.zh: 没有人在properly投资绿色氢能。
cues.en: Nobody is investing in green hydrogen properly.

cues.zh: 没有人在投资太阳能板和风力发电机
cues.en: Nobody is investing in solar panels and windmills

cues.zh: 这些实际上由社区拥有。
cues.en: that are actually owned by communities.

cues.zh: 他们所做的一切都是为了寡头。
cues.en: They are doing everything for the oligarchs.

cues.zh: 我认为DiEM25政策的第二块木板应该是
cues.en: The second plank of the DiEM25 policy, I think, should be a

cues.zh: 一个社会化的绿色能源联盟，将这一系统纳入其中，
cues.en: socialized green energy Union incorporating within the system,

cues.zh: 这个绿色能源生产和分配网络，所有权
cues.en: this network of green energy production and distribution with ownership rights

cues.zh: 归市政层面、区域层面，由公民大会监督，
cues.en: at the municipal level, the regional level, overseen by citizens' assemblies,

cues.zh: 由陪审团、随机选出的公民等等监督。
cues.en: by juries, randomly selected citizens and so on.

cues.zh: 我们必须做的第三件事——我知道这听起来有争议——
cues.en: And the third thing that we must do - and I know that that sounds controversial -

cues.zh: 结束对俄罗斯能源的制裁。
cues.en: end sanctions on Russian energy.

cues.zh: 唯一从对俄罗斯天然气和石油制裁中受益的人
cues.en: The only people who benefit from the sanctions on Russian gas and oil

cues.zh: 是俄罗斯寡头和欧洲寡头。
cues.en: are the Russian oligarchs and the European oligarchs.

cues.zh: 这没有帮助乌克兰，也没有削弱普京。
cues.en: It is not helping Ukraine, it is not undermining Putin.

cues.zh: 这只会让普京和他的寡头们更富有。
cues.en: It is enriching Putin and his oligarchs.

cues.zh: 而这些制裁只符合
cues.en: And the sanctions are only in the interest

cues.zh: 俄罗斯、乌克兰、
cues.en: of the United oligarchies of Russia, of Ukraine,

cues.zh: 德国、意大利和希腊联合寡头集团的利益。
cues.en: of Germany, of Italy and of Greece.
